visualBrief.primarySubject: Susan Prescott, the central person named by the story
visualBrief.scene: A restrained documentary technology-publication photograph of the central person publicly speaking, being interviewed, or addressing an industry audience in a context that directly matches the article.
supportingElements: softly blurred audience or event environment
Apple-specific event context without invented logos or text
visualBrief.composition: Medium or medium-wide horizontal frame; subject slightly off-center; back, side, over-the-shoulder, cropped, silhouette, or natural-distance framing so the face is not clearly identifiable.
avoid: glowing holograms, floating code, HUDs and neon sci-fi effects
prominent readable text or fake headlines
generic product hero replacing the person
random consumer electronics as the main subject
